'''Tanol Ocir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

==Biography==
Ocir learned how to carry out some of the modifications that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]] had made to his personal [[SD-X-series stealth battle droid]] and used this knowledge to modify a number of SD-Xs. When [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], the owner of the SD-X's manufacturer, [[Tendrando Arms]], found out, he was furious and placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Ocir and any [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that he had modified.
